help.sub: Koke okwenziwa ku-app, ngenkhombandlela efitjhani etjengisa ngokuqondileko bona kwenziwa njani. Akunakulandisa, ziinkrini kwaphela.
help.tourSub: Inkhombandlela esheshako yokufuna ilizwi lakho lokuthoma.

account.desc: Thuthukisa ihlelo begodu ulawule ukubhalisela kwakho.
ui.sentencePh: (Akukaphoqi) Tlola umutjho lapho ilizwi livela khona ukuze uthole ihlathululo linye elinembileko
ui.gadHint: Thepha nawuzwileko, ilizwi lizokutjhejwa njengelizwisisiweko ebhukwini lakho lamezwi
ui.gadDoneSub: Ilizwi litjhejwe njengelizwisisiweko ebhukwini lakho lamezwi.
ui.savedNote: Ilizwi leli neenhlathululo zalo zigcinwe ebhukwini lakho lamezwi, begodu ziyafumaneka ngitjho nalokha ungekho ku-inthanethi
ui.compose: Tlola owakho umutjho uqinisekise ukuthi uzwisise
ui.freeCount: {n} kwama-30 wamezwi ebhukwini lakho lamezwi lamahala
ui.installAndroid: Faka ngokuthepha kanye, i-Gadit ivuleka njenge-app yamambala esikrinini sakho sangaphambili.
ui.dupBody: Ufuna ukuphinda uhlanganise iphrofayili ekhona? Woke amezwi nokuthuthuka kugcinwa.
ui.reconnectNote: ✓ Ukuhlanganisa godu kubuyisa woke amezwi nokuthuthuka.
ui.joinSub: Tlola ikhodi enamadijithi asi-6 eyenziwe mzalakho
ui.leaderSub: Amezwi ahlukileko umuntu ngamunye awaseyitjhileko bekube nje
ui.recentSub: Elinye nelinye ilizwi abantwabakho abaliseyitjhako, amatjha qangi.
ui.alertsSub: Thola isaziso ngakho koke abantwabakho abakwenzako ku-Gadit: amezwi abawaseyitjhako, amadikteshini, izifundo, imidlalo nokufunda.
ui.alertNowSub: Isaziso msinyana nje nasebaseyitjhe ilizwi namkha baqede ukuzilolonga.
ui.hwPickPicSub: Yizwa ilizwi bese ukhetha isithombe salo kwamathathu
ui.ranksSub: Ubuthe amezwi ali-{n}. Ilizwi ngalinye elitjha likukhuphula phezulu
ui.toNext: Amezwi ali-{n} aseleko ukuze ukhuphuke ileveli
ui.readerSub: Namathisela itheksti, thatha isithombe sekhasi, layitjha isithombe namkha bamba isikrini sakho.
ui.tapHint: Thepha nanyana ngiliphi ilizwi ukubona ihlathululo yalo. Amezwi owavulileko aba luhlaza satjani.
ui.saySub: Tlola umutjho, ukhethe ilimi olifundako, bese uzwe bona kutjhiwo njani kuhle khulu.
ui.pasteListSub: Ilizwi linye emudeni ngamunye, ngelimi lakho namkha ngesiNgisi.
ui.pointsRule: Ilizwi elitjha = igadango eliya phezulu · Ukuqeda ukuzilolonga = ama-skin amatjha
ui.duelCardSub: Dlalani nilwisane: umzali nomntwana, abantakwenu namkha abangani.
ui.duelSub: Imibuzo efanako kubadlali bobabili. Onembileko notjheshako uyawina.
ui.dSameSub: Dluliselanani idivayisi phakathi kwabadlali embuzweni ngamunye.
ui.dInviteSub: Thumela ikhodi namkha ilinki ku-family namkha kumngani.
ui.dOnlineSub: Umdlali ongaziwa oneminyaka efana neyakho. Kubonakala kuphela igama lokudlala ne-avatar, akukho mabizo wangempela begodu akukho chat.
ui.duelKidsSub: Nawuvula lokhu, abantwabakho bangadlala i-Word Duel nabanye abantwana abalingana ngeminyaka abaku-inthanethi ngesikhathi esifanako. Babona kuphela igama lokudlala ne-avatar.
ui.cxBody: Usaqhubeka nokufinyelela koke bekuphele isikhathi sakho sanje. Ungaqalisa godu nanyana kunini ngaphambi kwalokho.
ui.pauseBody: Ungamisa ukubhalisa inyanga yinye, ngaphandle kokubhadhala. Koke kuhlala kunjengombana kunjalo, begodu ukubhalisa kuyaqhubeka ngokwako ngemva kwenyanga.
ui.renewBody: Itrayali yakho izokuqhubeka bekufike ekugcineni, begodu angekhe kube nokubhadeliswa.
demo.mySentence: Ikati lami elinelukuluku livule woke amabhoksi endlini.
demo.feedbackMsg: Kuhle, usebenzise elithi 'curious' ngendlela enembileko khulu.
demo.hwList: ihabhula, isikolo, umngani, phuzi, utitjhere, isimu
search.desc: Tlola namkha utjho ilizwi bese uthola zoke iinhlathululo zalo, iimbonelo, isithombe nemvelaphi yalo.
search.s1: Tlola ilizwi ebhokisini lokuseyitjha, namkha uthephe umayikhrofoni ulitjho.
search.s3: Thepha 'Isithombe' ngaphasi kwehlathululo ukuze ubone isithombe saso.
search.s4: Ekugcineni: lapho ilizwi livela khona, bese kuba nenkinobho ethi 'Gad it!'.
save.title: Ibhuku lakho lamezwi lizizalisa ngokwalo
save.desc: Elinye nelinye ilizwi oliseyitjhako ligcinwa ebhukwini lakho lamezwi ngokuzenzakalela.
save.s1: Elinye nelinye ilizwi oliseyitjhako ligcina ngokwalo, akukho okufanele ukuthephele.
save.s2: Ukubona amezwi wakho, vula 'Ibhuku lamezwi' phezulu emenwini.
save.s3: Amezwi wakho woke alapho, begodu emaplani abhadelwako asebenza nangaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
save.s4: Ku-Basic, ibhuku lamezwi lamahala ligcina amezwi afika kwama-30.
context.title: Ihlathululo elifaneleko lomutjho wakho
context.desc: Faka umutjho lapho ilizwi livela khona bese uthola ihlathululo elilodwa elifaneleko.
context.s1: Tlola ilizwi, bese ethemini engaphasi kwalo, utlola umutjho lapho livela khona.
context.s2: I-Gadit ikupha ihlathululo elilodwa elifaneleko kulowo mutjho.
context.s3: Ithemu elifanako lingaphasi kwebha yokuseyitjha ekhasini lawo woke amezwi.
wordpage.title: Okunengi ngelizwi ngalinye
wordpage.desc: Tlola owakho umutjho, uthole iimbonelo ezengeziweko begodu utjheje ilizwi njengelizwisisiweko.
wordpage.s1: Ngaphasi kwehlathululo, thepha 'Tlola owakho umutjho uqinisekise ukuthi uzwisise'.
wordpage.s2: Tlola namkha utjho umutjho wakho, thepha 'Hlola umutjho' bese uthola impendulo khona lapho.
wordpage.s3: Emaplani abhadelwako, '+ Eminye imitjho yesibonelo' yengeza iimbonelo ezintathu ezitja.
wordpage.s4: Ekugcineni, thepha 'Gad it!' begodu ilizwi litjhejwa njengelizwisisiweko ebhukwini lakho lamezwi.
extras.title: Imibuzo ngelizwi
extras.desc: Emaplani abhadelwako: okuphikisanako, amezwi afanako, umndeni welizwi, amaphutha ajayelekileko nokuthi ungalikhumbula njani.
extras.s1: Ngemva kwe-'Gad it!', elithi 'Unombuzo ngelizwi leli?' linikela imibuzo emihlanu.
extras.s2: Thepha umbuzo bese impendulo ivuleka ngenzasi kwawo.
kids.title: Imodi yabantwana
kids.desc: Iswitjhi sinye phezulu sichaza elinye nelinye ilizwi ngendlela ongachazela ngayo umntwana.
kids.s1: Ku-Family, vula iswitjhi ethi 'Abantwana' eceleni kwe-logo.
kids.s2: Nje ihlathululo yoke itlolwe ngendlela yomntwana.
kids.s3: Nayivuliweko, imenyu itjengisa 'Umsebenzi wesikolo' esikhundleni se-'Zilolonge'.
kids.s4: Kudivayisi ehlanganyelwako, vula 'Shared kids screen' ku-My family, bese umntwana ngamunye athephe isithombe sakhe.
install.desc: Faka i-Gadit esikrinini sakho sangaphambili ku-iPhone, namkha uyifake ku-Android.
install.s1: Ku-iPhone, vula i-gadit.app ku-Safari bese uthepha inkinobho ethi 'Abelana'.
install.s2: Skrola, ukhethe 'Faka esikrinini sangaphambili' bese uthepha 'Faka'.
install.s3: Ku-Android, faka i-app ye-Gadit ku-Google Play, namkha uthephe 'Faka' ku-Chrome.
install.s4: I-Gadit nje ivuleka nge-ayikhoni yayo, njengananyana ngiyiphi i-app.
addchild.title: Faka ilunga lomndeni
addchild.desc: Khetha indima, ibizo nombala, kube nabantwana abangafika kwabahlanu ku-Family.
addchild.s1: Ku-My family, kuthebhu ye-Family, thepha 'Faka ilunga lomndeni'.
addchild.s2: Khetha indima: Ubaba, Umma, Indodana namkha Indodakazi.
addchild.s3: Tlola ibizo, ukhethe umbala, wengeze iminyaka nawufuna, bese uthepha 'Faka ku-family'.
addchild.s4: Nangabe ibizo sele liku-family, ungahlanganisa godu iphrofayili leyo begodu ugcine amezwi wayo.
pair.desc: Hlanganisa idivayisi yomntwana ngekhodi ye-QR namkha ikhodi enamadijithi asi-6.
pair.s1: Kuthebhu ye-Family, thepha 'Hlanganisa idivayisi' ekhadini lomntwana.
pair.s2: Skena ikhodi ye-QR ngedivayisi yomntwana, namkha uvule i-gadit.app/join lapho bese utlola ikhodi.
pair.s3: Ku-iPhone, vula i-Gadit nge-ayikhoni yayo yesikrini sangaphambili bese uthepha 'Faka ikhodi'.
pair.s4: Tlola amadijithi asi-6, begodu umntwana ohlanganiswe godu uthola woke amezwi wakhe abuye.
dash.s1: Vula 'My family' emenwini ye-avatar, begodu ithebhu ethi Ekhaya ifinyeta i-family.
dash.s2: Umntwana ngamunye unekhadi elinamezwi, amalanga alandelanako, irenki namazwi wamuva.
dash.s3: Irhelo le-family litjengisa bona ngubani ngamunye wenu oseyitjhe amezwi amangaki.
dash.s4: 'Okusanda kuseyitjhwa' kubala elinye nelinye ilizwi abantwana abaliseyitjhako, amatjha qangi.
alerts.title: Izaziso ngabantwabakho
alerts.desc: Yizwa ngamazwi, amadikteshini, izifundo, imidlalo, ukufunda nama-duel.
alerts.s1: Ku-My family, ku-Iinlungiselelo, vula 'Ngitjele lokho abantwabami abakwenzako ku-Gadit'.
alerts.s3: Khetha ofuna ukuzwa ngakho, bese uvula izaziso kanye kuleyo naleyo divayisi.
alerts.s4: Izaziso zifika nge-imeyili, begodu njengebhanela yefowuni lapho kungenzeka khona.
homework.title: Umsebenzi wesikolo
homework.desc: Kubantwana abaku-Family: faka umsebenzi wesikolo ngesithombe namkha ngokunamathisela, bese niwuzilolonga.
homework.s1: Ku-'Umsebenzi wesikolo', thepha Thatha isithombe, Layitjha namkha Namathisela ukufaka umsebenzi wanamhlanjesi ebusuku.
homework.s2: Hlola amezwi, ukhethe ukuthi kuyini nokuthi ukuhlolwa kunini, bese uthepha Gcina.
homework.s3: Umsebenzi wesikolo ulinda ngaphasi kwe-'Okufanele kwenziwe', eceleni kokufunda amezwi, ukufunda nokulungiselela ukuhlolwa.
homework.s4: 'Ukufunda amezwi' kunedikteshini, lalela ukhethe, umdlalo weenthombe nezifundo zelimi.
ranks.title: Amarenki, amalanga alandelanako nerhelo le-family
ranks.desc: Elinye nelinye ilizwi elitjha likusondeza erenkini elandelako, begodu ukuzilolonga okuqediweko kuvula ama-skin amatjha.
ranks.s1: Thepha ibheji lerenki phezulu ukuze ubone amarenki wakho.
ranks.s2: Ilizwi ngalinye elitjha encwadini yakho likukhuphula emazingeni.
ranks.s3: Abantwana babona amalanga alandelanako, umgomo weveke nerenki yabo, begodu amarenki aphezulu avula ukubonakala okutjha.
ranks.s4: Irhelo le-family ku-My family litjengisa bona ngubani oseyitjhe amezwi amanengi khulu.
reader.desc: Thatha isithombe, namathisela namkha layitjha itheksti, thepha nanyana ngiliphi ilizwi, bese uhlola ukuthi uzwisise.
reader.s1: Ku-'Elinye nelinye ilizwi', namathisela itheksti, thatha isithombe sekhasi, layitjha isithombe namkha i-PDF, namkha wabelane ngesikrini sakho.
reader.s2: 'Amezwi aqakathekileko etheksthini le' atjengisa amezwi afanele ukufundwa qangi.
reader.s3: Thepha nanyana ngiliphi ilizwi ukuze ubone ihlathululo yalo, begodu elinye nelinye ilizwi olivulako liba luhlaza satjani.
reader.s4: Ekugcineni, ukuhlolwa kokufunda kubuza bona amezwi atjho ukuthini etheksthini.
say.title: Kutjho ngelinye ilimi
say.desc: Tlola umutjho, ukhethe ilimi, uwuzwe bese uzilolonga ukuwutjho.
say.s1: Ku-'Kutjho', tlola namkha uqophe umutjho bese ukhetha ilimi ofuna ukuwuzwa ngalo.
say.s2: Thepha 'Kutjho' bese uzwa ukuthi kuzwakala njani kuhle khulu.
say.s3: Bese uthepha 'Zilolongeni ukulitjho' bese ukutjho ngokuzwakalako.
say.s4: Uthola iinkwekwezi ezifinyelela kwezihlanu, neseluleko lokha kungakabi kuhle.
practice.title: Zilolonge
practice.desc: Kubadala abaku-Individual ne-Family: ukufunda, ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa, idikteshini nelimi.
practice.s2: Khetha kokune: ukufunda, ukuhlolwa, idikteshini namkha ilimi.
practice.s3: Mayelana nokuhlolwa, namathisela irhelo lamagama bese uzilolonga bekufike ilanga.
practice.s4: Edikteshinini uzwa ilizwi, ulitlole bese ubona upeledo olufaneleko.
games.title: Imidlalo yamagama
games.desc: Imidlalo ngamazwi asebhukwini lakho lamezwi, nokhunye okunengi.
games.s2: 'Ukusuka ebhukwini lakho lamezwi' kudlala ngamazwi owaseyitjhako.
games.s3: Ngaphasi kuneminye imidlalo ngemvelaphi yamazwi, amezwi anembileko nesakhiwo samazwi.
games.s4: Umdlalo ngamunye oqediweko ukusondeza ku-skin etjha.
duel.title: Word Duel
duel.desc: Imibuzo efanako nelwa ne-family, umngani namkha i-Word Bot.
duel.s2: Dlala kule divayisi, mema ngekhodi namkha ilinki, joyina ngekhodi, namkha udlale ne-Word Bot.
duel.s3: Ukuze umdlale nomuntu oku-inthanethi nje, umzali uvula 'Word Duel nabanye abantwana' ku-Iinlungiselelo.
duel.s4: Onembileko notjheshako uyawina, begodu ithebula lokuwina ligcina amaphuzu.
account.s1: Vula 'Akhawunti' emenwini ye-avatar ukuze ubone iplani yakho.
account.s4: Eplanini elibhadelwako, 'Phatha ukubhadelisa' no-'Tjhentjha iplani' kuphatha koke okuseleko.
cancel.title: Khansela, yimisa namkha vala ukuvuselela
cancel.desc: Kwenzekani nawukhansela, nezinye iindlela ezibandabanda endleleni.
cancel.s1: Ku-Akhawunti, thepha 'Cancel subscription' bese ukhetha isizathu nawufuna.
cancel.s2: Eplanini yenyanga, ungayimisa inyanga yinye esikhundleni salokho, ngaphandle kokubhadhala.
cancel.s3: Etrial yamahala, isizathu esithi 'Bengingafuni ukubhadeliswa ngokuzenzakalela' sikuvumela ukuvala ukuvuselela kwaphela.
cancel.s4: Nawutjhentjha umqondo, thepha 'Ngikhansela ngephoso, gcina ukubhalisa'.
